definition: to spend the night at someone's home
description: A mirror selfie of a young woman with curly dark hair in a long striped shirt and cream shorts, laughing as she holds up her phone in a friend's bedroom. Behind her a young woman in a white vest and shorts, her hair in a messy bun, jumps off the double bed with a blue duvet and bends down by the bed, laughing. On the patterned rug a dachshund sniffs an open overnight bag, with socks and a toothbrush lying on the floor. The room has yellow walls, a bookshelf and an orange ceiling lamp.
